ablations.note: Fast may skip content hash after metadata match; Strict always hashes. Not a reordering toggle — measures pair validation cost difference.
auto should avoid tracing short ETL; always pays cold+warm; never never caches

ablations.lazy_decode_note: CandidateBytes lazy decode is always on; no runtime eager toggle. Complexity measured via record_decode_ns / sqlite_query_ns under high-candidate-count-lookup bounds.
ablations.limit_note: SQL LIMIT equals TRACEJIT_CANDIDATE_BOUND; measured in high-candidate-count-lookup.
ablations.stream_staging_note: Stream-hash CAS staging is compile-time in Phase F tip; compare tip vs Phase E tip warm large_file cas_restore_ns.

suite.correctness_model_note: TraceJIT discovers deps via tracing + guards; bzip2 stores input mtime. Content-addressed tools key on bytes only and may ignore metadata.

correctness_model_notes.ccache_sccache_ninja: Not installed on this host — skipped, not claimed.
correctness_model_notes.make: mtime/graph based; preserved-mtime content edit and corrupted output can leave stale artifacts unless a content check is added.
correctness_model_notes.simple_cas: Hashes input bytes only; ignores TraceJIT-style path/metadata deps; recovers corrupted outputs on next run if input hash still matches.
correctness_model_notes.tracejit: Synchronous guards on observed deps; discovers deps automatically; may be slower on identical rerun but should not return stale bytes.

suite.warmup_note: single-shot phases (not median of many); competitive correctness focus
